value.rationale: For this established dynamical family, the finite-space spectrum is a natural exact invariant. The parity kernel and its semisimplicity tell which components of any polynomial density vanish after one iteration rather than merely bounding decay; the explicit nonzero rates determine every surviving degree. This is information one or two pair-correlation sequences cannot give, and requires the independent all-degree operator argument. No value credit rests on the covered pair formulas or on security implications.
